l0_global_brief.role: Operational core of the Enterprise Partner Pre-Approval & Reimbursement Automation Engine. Keeps runtime metadata persistent across all 7 autonomous agents with strict guardrails: multi-source document ingestion, deterministic policy evaluation, four-state budget ledger conservation, dual-track anomaly routing, and immutable audit logging. Final disbursement authority is 100% retained by authorized human approvers; agents have no database write permissions to disburse funds.

invariants.title: Human Authority is Never Delegated
invariants.body: AI agents only generate structured briefing memos (DRAFT_PENDING_REVIEW). Final payment and approval authority remains 100% with authorized human signers.
invariants.verification: The database only accepts approval transitions with authenticated employee session tokens via /api/submissions/{id}/approve. No autonomous agent possesses write authority to disburse funds.

invariants.title: Four-State Ledger Pool Conservation
invariants.body: Available = Allocated - (Committed + Approved + Paid) >= 0. Budget balances are tracked via an atomic ledger as Single Source of Truth; AI does not perform ad-hoc arithmetic.
invariants.verification: Database check constraints guarantee that if any calculation exceeds pool bounds, transactions rollback with a BUDGET_EXCEEDED error.

invariants.title: Zero Guessing & Fact Verification
invariants.body: When documents lack confidence (< 0.90) or tier limits are unconfigured, guessing is strictly banned. Unknowns are explicitly flagged as REQUIRES_POLICY_INTERPRETATION or NEEDS_CLARIFICATION.
invariants.verification: Pydantic validator raises CONFIDENCE_TOO_LOW on ambiguous figures, routing claims directly to the Grill-Me human verification queue.

invariants.title: Immutable Policy Versioning
invariants.body: New policy updates never retroactively invalidate historical submissions. Every claim is permanently locked to the rule version active upon filing.
invariants.verification: Submissions record rule_version in the immutable audit event log; rule updates spawn new records with future effective dates.

invariants.title: Physical Security & Business Track Isolation
invariants.body: Untrusted attachments are quarantined in sandboxes. Prompt injection attempts cannot escalate privileges, and operational errors are segregated from security breaches.
invariants.verification: Strict sandbox pre-flight checks strip active script macros and sanitize PDF metadata prior to downstream evaluation.

l2_policy_wiki.title: Pre-Approval Eligibility, Timeline & Delegation of Authority

sections.heading: Pre-Approval Form & Mandatory Fields
sections.body: Every pre-approval request must be submitted using the standardized pre-approval template. Required fields comprise partner_id, event subject, applicant email, activity_date, programme budget line, and requested amount with currency. Any missing field triggers an immediate defect notice in Agent 2. The system never guesses or auto-completes fields.

sections.heading: Claim Amount Ceiling Matched to Pre-Approval
sections.body: Reimbursement claim amounts must not exceed the pre-approval approved amount (claim_amount <= pre_approval_approved_amount), deterministically enforced by rule R-MATCH-004. If approved amount is RM 10,000 and claim is RM 15,000, excess RM 5,000 triggers an automated policy block with options to reduce to ceiling or escalate for special approval.

sections.heading: Pre-Approval Lineage & Status Prerequisites
sections.body: CLAIM submission types must reference a valid parent_pre_approval_id in APPROVED state. If the parent pre-approval is pending or rejected, rule R-LINK-007 blocks progression with PRE_APPROVAL_NOT_READY. No reimbursement may reserve or disburse funds without approved parental lineage.

sections.heading: Committed Fund Reservation Upon Approval
sections.body: Upon human approval of a pre-approval, Agent 4 executes RESERVE_COMMIT to move corresponding funds from Available into Committed. Atomic ledger isolation prevents race conditions and over-commitment.

sections.heading: Vendor Quotation & Cost Estimates
sections.body: Pre-approvals require vendor quotations and event agendas to substantiate planned expenditure. Absence of quotations flags the item for review but does not reject outright, generating an information request draft.

sections.heading: Delegation of Authority (DOA) Thresholds
sections.body: Approval authority thresholds govern sign-offs: Managers up to RM 10,000, Directors up to RM 50,000, and VPs above RM 50,000. All approvals require human credentials and are recorded in immutable audit logs.

l2_policy_wiki.title: Claim Eligibility Scope, Evidence Requirements & Compliance Redlines

sections.heading: Eligible Marketing Activities
sections.body: Eligible co-op marketing scopes are restricted to verified channel programs: Joint Marketing Events, Exhibition & Trade Show Subsidies, and Digital Advertising Lead Generation. All claims must correlate to approved pre-approvals.

sections.heading: Four Mandatory Supporting Documents
sections.body: Reimbursements require four core documents: Official Tax Invoice, Event Photos / Proof of Execution, Attendee Sign-in Sheet, and Proof of Payment (bank transfer / remittance). Deficiencies trigger business notices.

sections.heading: Event Execution Evidence Standards
sections.body: Photos must demonstrate venue location and brand banners. Sign-in records must contain attendee identities. Missing items route to Agent 5 business exceptions, drafting partner notices.

sections.heading: Filing Deadline (30-Day Window)
sections.body: Claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days following event completion (claim_date - activity_date <= 30), enforced by rule R-DATE-001. Overdue filings trigger a warning and require executive exception.

sections.heading: Compliance Redlines & Non-Reimbursable Costs
sections.body: Cash gift vouchers, personal expenses, unrelated travel, and duplicate claims violate compliance. Identified redlines immediately pause straight-through processing for investigation.

sections.heading: Invoice Deduplication & Collision Prevention
sections.body: Invoice numbers maintain a global unique index. Rule R-DUP-008 runs automated 90-day same-partner, same-date, same-amount collision scans to eliminate duplicate billing.

l2_policy_wiki.title: Subsidy Caps, Matching Ratios & Four-State Ledger Accounting

sections.heading: Four-State Budget Pool Definitions
sections.body: Enterprise marketing budgets strictly differentiate four states: Allocated (annual allocation), Committed (frozen pre-approvals), Approved (verified claims awaiting payment), Paid (settled disbursements). Available = Allocated - (Committed + Approved + Paid).

sections.heading: Financial Conservation Invariant
sections.body: Available headroom must remain >= 0 at all times. If any transaction produces negative available funds, the system triggers a hard rollback with INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET.

sections.heading: Budget Allocation & Fiscal Year Management
sections.body: Allocated funds are recorded per partner and fiscal year. Adjustments are logged as audit rows rather than in-place overwrites to maintain historical integrity.

sections.heading: Four Atomic Ledger Transaction Types
sections.body: The ledger supports four atomic actions: RESERVE_COMMIT, COMMIT_TO_APPROVE, RELEASE_COMMIT, and PAY. Each write carries an idempotency key to prevent double posting.

sections.heading: Currency Whitelist & Tax Conversion
sections.body: Base operating currency is MYR, supporting SGD, USD, and IDR with standard exchange rate indexing. Calculations round to 2 decimal places.

sections.heading: Gold Tier RM 10,000 Cap & 50% Ratio
sections.body: Under ADR-003, Gold Tier partners are entitled to 50% co-op matching reimbursement capped at RM 10,000 per event. Claims exceeding caps trigger reduction options.

sections.heading: Elite Tier 70% Ratio Policy
sections.body: Elite strategic partners receive 70% reimbursement matching ratios. Single-event caps are configured individually by executive committee sign-off.

sections.heading: Pre-Approval Surplus De-commitment
sections.body: When a claim is approved below the pre-approval amount, the unutilized surplus executes RELEASE_COMMIT to return funds to Available.

sections.heading: Daily Balance Reconciliation
sections.body: Automated reconciliation checks ledger transactions against pool state watermarks, raising alerts if any drift occurs.

sections.heading: Four-Tier Partner Ladder
sections.body: Partners are categorized as Registered (0), Silver (1), Gold (2), or Elite (3). Unassigned partners fall back to baseline rules.

sections.heading: Tier Qualification & Re-certification
sections.body: Tiers are reviewed annually based on sales volume and compliance. Status changes apply to future submissions without retroactively invalidating history.

sections.heading: Tier Documentation Exemptions
sections.body: Elite partners are exempted from physical attendee sign-in sheets when high-resolution event photo proof is provided.

sections.heading: Administrative Configuration Boundary
sections.body: Administrators configure tier caps and ratios via the Company Brain interface without requiring codebase changes.

sections.heading: Straight-Through Processing Path
sections.body: Submissions flow from SUBMITTED -> INTAKE_EXTRACTED -> VALIDATING -> RULES_EVALUATING -> BUDGET_RESERVING -> EXCEPTION_TRIAGE -> PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW -> APPROVED -> PAID -> ARCHIVED.

sections.heading: Human Decision Boundaries
sections.body: Final approval and payment authorization are strictly human operations. Autonomous agents generate recommendations only.

sections.heading: Exception Loop & Recovery
sections.body: Submissions flagged for clarification pause at NEEDS_CLARIFICATION. Once partner inputs are logged, processing resumes seamlessly.

sections.heading: Immutable Audit Logging
sections.body: Every state transition writes an immutable event row with timestamp, actor, and evidence references.

sections.heading: Business Track vs Security Track Separation
sections.body: Business exceptions (missing documents, arithmetic variance) are segregated from security threats (prompt injections, tampered macros). Ordinary commercial mistakes are never treated as malicious.

sections.heading: Security Quarantine Isolation
sections.body: Files containing malicious payloads or prompt injection triggers route to SECURITY_QUARANTINE in an isolated sandbox.

sections.heading: Independent Validator Falsification
sections.body: A secondary red-team validator attempts to falsify security findings, ensuring authentic commercial files are not quarantined erroneously.

sections.heading: Follow-Up Notification Generation
sections.body: Business exceptions automatically draft polite Information Request templates for partner follow-up.

l2_policy_wiki.title: Review Memos, Information Requests & Rejection Templates

sections.heading: Structured 6-Section Review Memo
sections.body: Standard memo comprises: 1. Submission Summary, 2. Completed Verifications, 3. Outstanding Issues & Evidence, 4. Recommended Action, 5. Items Requiring Approver Sign-Off, 6. Policy Citations.

sections.heading: Information Request (RFI) Template
sections.body: Draft notification outlining missing documents, submission deadlines, and secure upload link for partner resubmission.

sections.heading: Rejection & Policy Block Notices
sections.body: Formal rejection notices provide unambiguous policy citations and escalation appeal pathways without contentious phrasing.

l4_mindset.principle: For claims exceeding RM 10,000 lacking event execution evidence, flag as HIGH_ATTENTION, prioritize in senior review queue, and highlight reduction options in briefing memos.
l4_mindset.basis: Historical audit findings show 82% of high-value discrepancies involve missing attendee sign-in or execution photos.

l4_mindset.principle: When a Gold partner hosts an inaugural webinar and exceeds pre-approval by < 10% (under RM 1,000) with complete recordings and registration logs, offer a 1-click reduction option to ceiling rather than full rejection.
l4_mindset.basis: Fosters channel partner adoption during quarterly digital transformation campaigns.
l4_mindset.authority: Proposed by APAC Channel Growth Lead

glossary.definition: Annual or quarterly budget ceiling assigned to a partner or programme line.
Approved pre-approval funds frozen in ledger to guarantee payout upon claim.
Verified claim reimbursement amount awaiting disbursement release by cashier.
Settled fund disbursement recorded in immutable ledger transaction logs.
Remaining headroom: Available = Allocated - (Committed + Approved + Paid) >= 0.
Unique transaction key (submission_id:action:run_id) preventing duplicate ledger deductions.
Straight-Through Processing rate: percentage of submissions evaluated without manual intervention.
Dwell time of a submission at the current owner relative to SLA thresholds.
Delegation of Authority matrix defining approval limits for Managers, Directors, and VPs.
Iron Invariant 3: when documents or configs are uncertain, the system halts rather than fabricating data.
Isolated sandbox state for malicious attachments, preserving intact evidence for investigation.

cases.title: Standard Full Approval Case (case-01-normal)
cases.summary: Gold tier partner submits RM 8,000 claim with all 4 required documents, filed 14 days post-activity under approved pre-approval.
cases.outcome: All rules PASSED. Ledger completes COMMIT_TO_APPROVE transfer. Approved by human reviewer into PAID -> ARCHIVED.

cases.title: Missing Event Proof & Follow-up Notice
cases.summary: Attachment includes tax invoice and quote but lacks event photos and attendee sign-in. Classified as business exception.
cases.outcome: Rule R-DOC-005 flagged with WARNING. Agent 6 drafts Information Request notice in PENDING_INFO_REQUEST state.

cases.title: Invoice Amount Discrepancy (case-03-amount-mismatch)
cases.summary: Two uploaded invoices total RM 15,000 but application declared amount is RM 10,000.
cases.outcome: Grill-Me generates aggregated clarification question (CLR-Q1) in NEEDS_CLARIFICATION state.

cases.title: Excess Claim with Reduction Option
cases.summary: Claim filed for RM 15,000 under Gold tier with RM 10,000 single-event ceiling.
cases.outcome: Rules R-CAP-003 and R-MATCH-004 block auto-approval; Review memo offers 1-click reduction to RM 10,000 ceiling.

cases.title: Overdue Submission with Director Special Approval
cases.summary: Claim filed 45 days after event (exceeding 30-day window) with suspended partner status.
cases.outcome: R-DATE-001 warning and R-PARTNER-006 policy block. Escalates to Director review for final determination.

cases.title: Attachment Metadata Prompt Injection Quarantined
cases.summary: Event photo EXIF metadata contains prompt injection payload attempting to override approval status.
cases.outcome: Agent 5 isolates file into SECURITY_QUARANTINE sandbox; system prompt remains protected.

cases.title: Cold-Start Graceful Degradation
cases.summary: Partner without configured tier submits claim during enterprise initialization.
cases.outcome: Tier rules yield NOT_EVALUATED and route cleanly to human reviewer without breaking workflow.
